title: Volmoed, Oudtshoorn (farm area, approx.): girl, 17, found dead, 3 Oct
summary: Police found a 17-year-old girl dead on a bed with head injuries at a house in Kliplokasie on Volmoed farm, outside Oudtshoorn, on Saturday night 3 October, and launched a murder investigation; a 26-year-old man was arre...
story: Police found a 17-year-old girl dead on a bed with head injuries at a house in Kliplokasie on Volmoed farm, outside Oudtshoorn, on Saturday night 3 October, and launched a murder investigation; a 26-year-old man was arrested (Cape Argus, quoting police spokesperson Christopher Spies). Her aunt says she was struck and strangled.
incident: Sat 3 Oct 2026, night (article of Wed 7 Oct says 'Saturday night')
location_note: A house in Kliplokasie on Volmoed farm, Oudtshoorn. The farm house is not on the map, so the pin is the Volmoed area point.

provenance.note: One report. The police statement, plus the victim's aunt.

sources.name: Warrant Officer Christopher Spies, Southern Cape police
sources.quote: officers found the teenager’s body lying on a bed with head injuries.

facts.label: Date and time
facts.claim: Found Saturday night, 3 October; police response about 21:40.
facts.detail: Aunt gives Saturday evening narrative; 21:40 comes from police-attributed outlet prose. Day number is inferred from Saturday before report date. Birthday tomorrow (Wednesday) versus 7 October dateline is an unrelated timing discrepancy.

sources.name: Angelina Botha, aunt
sources.quote: Later that evening, we received the news that she was found dead in her boyfriend’s house.

facts.label: Place
facts.claim: House in Kliplokasie on Volmoed farm; farm-area marker only.
facts.basis: Report does not identify the original source

sources.name: Cape Argus, origin not stated
sources.quote: found dead at a house in Kliplokasie on Volmoed farm on Saturday night.

facts.label: Method
facts.claim: Aunt reports blunt-force head injuries and strangulation; police describe head injuries only.
facts.detail: Aunt also states neck markings indicate strangulation; police report only head injuries. Keep family attribution and do not turn this into an autopsy finding independently checked by FORGE.

sources.name: Angelina Botha, aunt
sources.quote: We were told that Sharuney was hit with a blunt object to the head multiple times.

facts.label: Reported motive
facts.claim: Underlying motive not stated; aunt relays a preceding family argument.
facts.basis: Not reported in the saved sources

facts.label: Legal status
facts.claim: Murder investigation; man, 26, arrested and expected in court Tuesday.
facts.detail: A 26-year-old arrest and planned Tuesday appearance are given in Cape Argus narration, not explicitly attributed to a spokesperson. Do not assert the appearance took place.

sources.name: Southern Cape police
sources.quote: Police confirmed that a murder investigation was launched after officers responded to the scene at about 9.40pm.
